# Discord bot agent

**Run an AI agent on Discord: webhook or bot, least-privilege invite, intents, slash commands, owner-only buttons, rate limits, AI label.**

Puts an AI agent on Discord safely — choosing a webhook or a bot, creating the application and bot user, least-privilege invite permissions, gateway intents (Message Content is privileged), slash commands registered per guild, HTTP interactions with ed25519 signature checks, owner-only Approve / Deny buttons, Discord's rate limits, and labelling the agent as AI. Use when someone wants an agent to post announcements, answer /ask questions or route approvals in a Discord server, connect Discord with @useclaudia/social or the claudia CLI, or audit a Discord bot's permissions, intents and labels.

| Category | Level | Time | Uses | Version |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [Build](../README.md) | intermediate | 1–2 h | `@useclaudia/social`, `@useclaudia/cli` | 1.0.0 · 2026-10-12 |

## How it works

1. Pick webhook, bot, or both
2. Create the app and lock the invite
3. Switch on only the intents you use
4. Register slash commands per server
5. Answer within three seconds
6. Verify every HTTP interaction
7. Gate approvals behind the owner
8. Treat members' words as outside content
9. Post through the social package

The full instructions are in **[SKILL.md](SKILL.md)**: when to use it, what you need, every step, the checks before you
finish, and the pitfalls.

## Install

```sh
# Claude Code (all projects on this machine)
mkdir -p ~/.claude/skills
curl -fsSLo /tmp/discord-bot-agent.zip https://useclaudia.xyz/skills/discord-bot-agent.zip
unzip -oq /tmp/discord-bot-agent.zip -d ~/.claude/skills

# Codex and other agents that read ~/.agents/skills
mkdir -p ~/.agents/skills && unzip -oq /tmp/discord-bot-agent.zip -d ~/.agents/skills
```

Or straight from GitHub with the [`skills` CLI](https://github.com/vercel-labs/skills):
`npx skills add claudia-onchain/Claudia-Skills --skill discord-bot-agent`.

In the Claude apps: **Customize → Skills → + → Upload a skill**, and pick `discord-bot-agent.zip` (don't unzip it).
More apps: [install a skill](../../../README.md#install-a-skill).

Then ask for the task in your own words, or call it directly with `/discord-bot-agent`.
